doc.title: Sheila Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Middleburgh, New York, May 11, 2002

title: Opening and setting at Sheila Jordan's house near Middleburgh
summary: Monk Rowe opens the filming and thanks Jordan for hosting; they chat about the remote location.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive outside Middleburgh, New York. I’m very pleased to have jazz musician Sheila Jordan with me today. Thank you for inviting us into your house.
Not exactly on the beaten path.
Well it’s a little bit out — they don’t call it “Hunter’s Land” for nothing. I mean there’s so many wild animals running around up here. But I like it.
How long have you been here.
